summary_1line: The crane sage Rajadharman hospitably receives the poor Brahmana Gautama and directs him to the Rakshasa king Virupaksha to obtain wealth.

image_candidates.scene_text: Under a vast umbrella-like banyan on golden sand, the exhausted Brahmana Gautama sleeps as a perfumed evening breeze moves through flowering trees.
The radiant crane prince Rajadharman, adorned with shining ornaments, welcomes the weary Brahmana at twilight beneath the banyan tree.
The great crane fans the resting Gautama with his wings beside a small fire and fresh fish laid out as guest offerings.
